name: Interpreter
summary: Given a language, defines a representation for its grammar together with an interpreter that uses that representation to interpret sentences of the language.

roles.name: AbstractExpression
roles.summary: Declares the interpretation operation shared by every node of the syntax tree.

roles.name: TerminalExpression
roles.summary: Interprets a terminal symbol of the grammar: it has no sub expression.

roles.name: NonterminalExpression
roles.summary: Interprets a grammar rule by delegating to its sub expressions.

roles.name: Context
roles.summary: Carries the information global to the interpretation.
